articles.title: EXCLUSIVE! Grammy Winner Ciara Talks Fashion, Her Favorite Throwback Song and Why She Loves “Living Young”
articles.content:
**独家专访：格莱美获奖歌手西雅拉谈时尚、经典歌曲和热爱“活在当下”**

西雅拉（Ciara）是少数能够平衡音乐、母职和时尚的艺人之一。这位格莱美奖得主、歌手、词曲作者和舞蹈家获得了11项格莱美提名，并奉献出了《Goodies》、《1, 2 Step》和《Level Up》等经典热门单曲（她也在过去的20年里为舞池设定了新标准）。幕后，她是四个孩子——Future、Sienna、Win和Amora的奉献母亲，也是与丈夫Russell Wilson一起的好莱坞最佳权力夫妻之一。

在《读者文摘》的独家专访中，西雅拉分享了她在过去20年公众视野中的心得体会——从年龄带来的信心到日常习惯如何让她保持最佳状态。她还揭露了与一家知名折扣零售商的令人兴奋的新合作，证明时尚不需要奢侈的预算也能玩得很开心。

当然，我们也要回顾她职业生涯中最具标志性的时期之一。她是否听腻了《1, 2 Step》？她的孩子们会跳这个舞步吗？她希望给年轻时的自己什么建议？继续阅读，了解西雅拉的真诚回答，一些幕后回忆和一些小惊喜。

**西雅拉：Ross一直是我们家的最爱。我们很自豪地有自己的儿童品牌3BRAND在Ross店铺中销售，因此从一开始就有一种自然的联系。当我与团队一起讨论愿景时，我非常兴奋。这不是一个小的、可爱或滑稽的想法。我们决定要大胆，要创造影响，要跳出框框思考。**

**西雅拉：我的衣柜因天而异。当整理得当时，它就像走进一家商店，因为我喜欢能够看到所有的服装和关键部件，尤其是作为母亲，因为你总是奔波不停。**

**我真的很喜欢按类别整理我的鞋子。有专门的运动鞋区、带带的高跟鞋区、平底鞋区等——这些区域是针对具体物品的，这也帮助了我。**

**西雅拉：进入母职后，我学到的时尚的有趣之处在于，时尚没有限制。我们在日常生活中表达自我的最佳方式之一就是通过我们穿的衣服。它可以告诉别人很多关于你的情绪。它可以告诉别人你想在房间里或舞台上创造的声音。**

**对于我来说，这是一个非常有趣的挑战。仅仅因为你成为了一位母亲，不意味着你变老了。不意味着你必须以某种特定的方式穿衣服。你可以在人生的每一个篇章和阶段都保持真我。有时候我会非常喜欢宽松的衣服，我一直都有这种喜好。我是个男孩子气的女孩，你知道吗？或者，我会选择更女性化的剪裁，因为尽管我是个男孩子气的女孩，但我也会挑战自己，让自己变得柔和一些，同时保持我的风格。**

**西雅拉：当我第一次进入这个行业时，我认为自己是无畏且自信的，但也有一部分的我正在尝试尽可能多地承担，尽可能快地承担，并试图搞懂一切。当你这样做时，肯定会有许多的尝试和错误。事物的初始阶段往往是最好的阶段，因为你可以了解很多关于自己的信息，并随着时间通过好与坏形成智慧。**

**我的第一张专辑发布已经22年了。我感觉不再那么年轻，但距离我的青春女性阶段还很近。我仍然喜欢年轻时的生活方式。拥有孩子和家庭帮助了我。我也是一只“狮子”（指年长的女性追求年轻男性）。我的丈夫比我年轻。我有所有这些因素帮助我保持年轻，同时我也能利用我的智慧。我喜欢自己在精神上和整体上的状态。**

**西雅拉：我认为这非常有动力，也让我感到非常自豪，因为我知道我有一系列随着时间推移而流行的歌曲。《1, 2 Step》对我来说几乎就像Mariah Carey的《我唯一想要的圣诞礼物》。这是DJ总会播放并演唱的歌曲。同样，我的其他歌曲如《Level Up》也让我感到自豪，因为这是我第一次独立发行的歌曲。当人们使用你的音乐时，尤其是当年轻一代像它是全新的歌曲一样使用它时，这是一件礼物。**

**西雅拉：我女儿在去露营的路上要求播放《Level Up》。她告诉她的弟弟和妹妹与她一起跳舞，我觉得这太可爱了。有趣的是，我家里不常播放我的音乐。这太奇怪了。也许我应该开始多做一些，因为我的孩子们可能应该知道妈妈的音乐。**

**西雅拉：我认为特殊的时刻就是第一次在片场遇见Missy。我们建立了联系，从那以后，她一直像我的姐姐一样。当我们开始我们的场景时，在实际音乐视频的片场，我开始跳这个步伐，她随即加入。**

**在老家拍摄这个视频真的很有趣，片场设在Cascade滑冰场。这让我感到怀旧，因为我是在滑冰场长大跳舞的，与像Missy这样的偶像在同一片场真的很特别。我们总是能完美地配合彼此。**

**西雅拉：今年夏天非常炎热。但对于我的家庭来说，夏季的传统之一是旅行，这总是很有趣。今年夏天我们没有旅行那么多，这也很好，因为看着我的孩子们在后院奔跑、玩耍，只是做孩子的事，是最甜美的事情之一。玩像Uno这样的游戏也总是很有趣，它永远不会过时。**

**西雅拉：我对我的最新发布非常兴奋。这首歌叫做《Yay》，是一首非常棒的曲子，由Thom Bridges制作，与我、Courtlin Jabrae、Rachel West和其他几位优秀的词曲作者合作创作。我对这首歌感到非常兴奋，因为它非常让人感觉良好。正适合夏天。**

**西雅拉：下个月我将首次前往波兰参加BitterSweet音乐节。这应该会很棒，还有几件有趣的事我暂时不能透露。可能整体的主题就是保持活动和努力在所做的一切中成为最好的自己。**
articles.summary:
Few artists have balanced music, motherhood and style quite like Ciara. The Grammy Award–winning singer, songwriter and dancer has earned 11 Grammy nominations and delivered iconic hits like “Goodies,” “1, 2 Step” and “Level Up.” (She’s also spent two decades setting the bar impossibly high for the rest of us on the dance floor.) Offstage, she’s a devoted mom to four children—Future, Sienna, Win and Amora—and one half of one of Hollywood’s favorite power couples alongside husband Russell Wilson.

In an exclusive interview with Reader’s Digest, Ciara opened up about the lessons she’s learned over the course of her two decades in the spotlight—from the confidence that comes with age to the everyday habits that help her feel her best. She also shared details about an exciting new partnership with a well-known off-price retailer, proving you don’t need a luxury budget to have fun with fashion.

And, of course, we had to revisit one of the most iconic eras of her career. Does she ever get tired of hearing “1, 2 Step”? Do her kids know the choreography? And what advice does she wish she could give her younger self? Read on for Ciara’s candid answers, a little behind-the-scenes nostalgia and a few surprises along the way.

Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more celebrity interviews, fun facts, humor, cleaning, travel and tech all week long.

This interview took place on July 9, 2026, and has been edited for length and clarity.

Reader’s Digest: You recently partnered with Ross Dress for Less for their new creative campaign, Ross World, that’s all about celebrating style and self-expression. What made this collaboration feel like a natural fit for you?

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by @ross


Ciara: Our family is a big fan of Ross. We proudly have our kid brand, 3BRAND, in Ross stores, so there was an organic connection already out the gate. I was super excited when I got together with the team to talk about the vision. It wasn’t a little cute, goofy idea. It was like, let’s be bold, let’s make some noise and let’s think outside the box.

Reader’s Digest: It’s great to be able to work with a brand that you can relate to. As you mentioned, Ross is very bold and expressive—qualities your style represents. What does your closet look like?

Ciara: My closet depends on the day. When organized, it’s like walking into a store because I like to be able to see all of the pieces and key pieces I need to grab—especially being a mom, because you’re always on the go.

I really do love organizing my shoes by category. There’s a section for my sneakers. There’s a section for my strappy heels, my platforms—like, there are sections that are specific to the actual item, which also helps me as well.

Reader’s Digest: When I think of your high-fashion looks, two that stand out to me the most are your 2026 Met Gala golden outfit and your iconic baby bump outfit at the Color Purple premiere in 2023. How has experiencing new seasons of your life changed the way you approach fashion, and which style choices have made you feel the most like yourself?

Ciara: The fun thing about fashion that I learned, especially when I entered motherhood, is that there’s no limitation to fashion. One of the best ways that we express ourselves in our everyday lives is through what we wear. It can tell a lot about your mood. It can tell a lot about the noise you want to make in the room or the noise you want to make on stage.

For me, that was such a fun challenge, entering motherhood. Just because you become a mom doesn’t mean that you’re older. It doesn’t mean that you have to dress a specific way. You can still be who you are through every chapter and phase of your life. Sometimes I’ll be really into oversized clothing, which I’m kind of always expecting. I’m a tomboy, you know? Or, I’d do more of a feminine silhouette, because [even though] I am a tomboy, I’m gonna challenge myself to soften it up a bit but still keep my edge.

Reader’s Digest: You’ve had an amazing career. When you look back at the younger Ciara who first entered the music industry, what would you say is the biggest way that you’ve changed, and what part of her do you think is exactly the same?

Ciara: When I first entered the industry, I think I was definitely fearless and confident, but there was also a part of me that was trying to take on as much as I could, as fast as I could, and trying to figure it all out. When you do that, there’s definitely a lot of trial and error. The beginning stages of things are sort of your best stages because you get to learn a lot about yourself, and you get to form wisdom over time through the good and the bad.

It’s been 22 years since my first album. I don’t feel quite as young, but I feel pretty close to my youthful-woman phases. I still love living young. Having my babies and my family helps. I’m also a cougar. My husband is younger than me. I have all these factors that help me live young, but also I’m able to use my wits at the same time. I like where I am mentally and holistically.

Reader’s Digest: One of your most iconic throwback songs of the 2000s, “1, 2 Step,” is still everywhere. It’s on TikTok. It’s definitely on people’s playlists. What’s it like to see people who weren’t even born when it came out still dancing to that song?

Ciara: I think it’s so motivating, and it makes me so proud to know that I have a catalog of songs that move with time. “1, 2 Step,” for me, is almost like my “All I Want for Christmas” by Mariah Carey. It’s a song the DJ will always play and sing. Same with my [other] songs like “Level Up,” which I’m proud of because that was my first independent release. It’s such a gift when people use your music—and when the younger generation uses it like it’s a new song all over again.

Reader’s Digest: Do your kids know the steps for “1, 2 Step” and “Level Up”?

Ciara: One of my daughters actually requested “Level Up” on the way to camp. She was telling her brother and sister to dance with her, and I thought that was so cute. It’s funny because I don’t play my music in the house like that. It’s so weird. Maybe I should start doing it a little bit more because my babies probably should know mommy’s music.

Reader’s Digest: It’s never too late! Do you have a favorite memory from when you and Missy mastered some of those moves?

Ciara: I think the special moment would be meeting Missy for the first time on set. We bonded, and ever since then, she’s been like a sister to me. When we started our scene together, on the set of the actual music video, I would start doing this step, and she would join right in with me.

It was really fun being in my hometown and shooting that video in Cascade Skating Rink. There was nostalgia for me because I came up dancing in the skating rinks, and to have an icon like Missy on set with me was really special. We’ve always been in sync with each other.

Reader’s Digest: It’s amazing to know that your friendship with Missy has been so long-lasting. When it comes to your past and most recent music, summer matches your energy. What’s a family tradition or summer activity that you and your family always look forward to?

Ciara: This summer’s been incredibly hot. But when it comes to summer traditions for my family and I, we travel some, which is always fun. We haven’t traveled as much this summer, which is kind of cool because just watching my kids run around, play in the backyard and just be kids is one of the sweetest things. Playing games like Uno is always fun too. It never gets old.

Reader’s Digest: What’s next for you, musically, creatively or personally?

Ciara: I’m super pumped about my latest release. The song is called “Yay,” and it’s such a good track produced by Thom Bridges and co-written by myself, Courtlin Jabrae, Rachel West and a few other amazing writers. I’m super pumped about this song because it’s super feel-good. It’s right on time for summer.

I’ll be traveling to Poland next month for the first time for the BitterSweet Festival. That should be really cool, and there are a couple of other fun things in my bag that I can’t quite share yet. That’s probably the overall theme: staying moving and trying to be my best at everything I do.

Rapid response with Ciara

Reader’s Digest: Let’s do some rapid-response questions. First up: Dogs or cats?

Ciara: Dogs.

Reader’s Digest: Mornings or nights?

Ciara: Nights.

Reader’s Digest: Aisle seat or window?

Ciara: Window.

Reader’s Digest: What’s your favorite book?

Ciara: I haven’t read this book in a long time, but I like The 48 Laws of Power.

*Editor’s note: Reader’s Digest does not endorse any specific products or services. 

Why trust us

At Reader’s Digest, we’re committed to producing high-quality content by writers with expertise and experience in their field in consultation with relevant, qualified experts. We rely on reputable primary sources, including government and professional organizations and academic institutions as well as our writers’ personal experiences where appropriate. For this interview with Ciara, Reader’s Digest Associate Editor Mariah Thomas tapped her experiences as a celebrity interviewer, writer and editor. We verify all facts and data, back them with credible sourcing and revisit them over time to ensure they remain accurate and up to date. Read more about our team, our contributors and our editorial policies.

articles.title: Royal Baby Alert! The Monarchy’s Newest Family Member Just Made Her Big Debut—And We Have All the Details
articles.content:
**皇室喜讯！王室新成员闪亮登场，细节尽觅**

皇室观察家们沸腾了！宫廷最新宣布，新晋宝宝降生啦，而且超级可爱！虽然只能看到她苹果般红润的脸颊和小耳垂，但这已经足够迷人。这是皇室婴儿一年多来首次在宫廷现身，上一次是2025年1月，贝阿特丽丝公主和丈夫爱德华多·马佩利·莫齐迎来女儿阿特娜。

新生儿是尤金妮公主和丈夫杰克·布鲁克斯班克的第三个孩子，也是他们的第一个女儿。她于8月3日在葡萄牙里斯本一家医院出生，父母自2022年起便分居于此。皇室在官方Instagram账户宣布，宝宝在当地时间下午6:20分安全诞生，体重6磅9盎司。

命名尚未公布，但根据惯例，皇室宝宝命名通常需要几日（如威廉和凯特三子乔治、夏洛特、路易斯）至一周（如尤金妮本人）。不过也有例外，1948年，查尔斯王子的名字公布用了一个多月。

尤金妮和杰克已育有两子：6岁的奥古斯特·菲利普·霍克·布鲁克斯班克（昵称奥吉）和3岁的厄内斯特·乔治·罗尼·布鲁克斯班克。今年5月，尤金妮宣布怀孕时，两兄弟曾在社交媒体上展示超声波照片，欢迎“新成员”。

新宝宝目前位列英国王位继承序列第15位，母亲尤金妮排第12，哥哥奥吉和厄内斯特分列第13和14位（父亲杰克不在名单中）。

尤金妮是前王子安德鲁和前妻萨拉·弗格森之女，两人因涉及杰弗里·埃普斯坦丑闻，近年地位下降。自此，尤金妮一家在皇室活动中逐渐淡出。今年6月，尤金妮和姐姐贝阿特丽丝虽获邀参加安妮公主之子彼得·菲利普斯的婚礼，但据内部消息，威廉王子和凯特王妃对她们态度冷淡。今年复活节，两姐妹也未出席皇室庆祝活动，宫廷当时表示未来或会邀请她们参与其他活动。

不过，新生命的到来总能化解僵局。也许这次官方Instagram账户发布的公告，预示着困境中的尤金妮姐妹能重返公众视野。
articles.summary:
It’s a girl!

Royal watchers are over the moon at the latest announcement from the palace. Yep, there’s a new baby in town, and wow, is she cute! Well, at least the part we can see is cute. In her first official photograph, the new arrival is clad in a pink onesie with just a peek of red cheek and cute little earlobe visible. But we’ll take it.

It’s been more than a year since we’ve had a royal baby gracing the palace grounds, when Princess Beatrice and husband Edoardo Mapelli Mozzi welcomed baby Athena in January 2025. Read on to learn all about the latest royal family member, and join us as we say welcome to the world, baby girl!

Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more royals, cleaning, humor, travel, tech and fun facts all week long.

Which royals just welcomed a baby girl?

Princess Eugenie and her husband, Jack Brooksbank. The newest member of the royal family was born on Aug. 3 at a hospital in Lisbon, Portugal, where her parents have split their time since 2022. The royal family shared on its official Instagram account that the baby arrived safely at 6:20 p.m. local time and weighed 6 pounds, 9 ounces.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by The Royal Family (@theroyalfamily)

What’s her name?

That’s a great question, and we’ll be the first to update you when we find out.

Hopefully, we won’t have to wait long. The typical wait for a royal baby name announcement runs anywhere from a couple of days (as with Kate and William’s children, George, Charlotte and Louis), to a week, like with Eugenie herself. Occasionally, though, the wait stretches longer: Back in 1948, the public had to wait more than a month to learn what Charles’s name would be!

Is this the couple’s first baby?

Nope, but it is their first girl. Eugenie and Jack also have two sons, August Philip Hawke Brooksbank (nicknamed Augie) and Ernest George Ronnie Brooksbank. Augie is now 6 years old, and little Ernest is 3.

The two boys made the social media rounds in May when Eugenie announced her pregnancy. In a sweet photo, Augie and Ernest were seen holding an ultrasound picture of their now-arrived baby sister.

The new baby lands at 15th in the line of succession to the British throne. Her mother, Eugenie, is 12th, and her brothers are 13th and 14th. (Dad Jack is not included in the lineup.)

Why did this announcement come as a bit of a surprise?

Eugenie is the daughter of the disgraced former prince Andrew and his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson, who have both seen their status fall in recent years after their involvement with Jeffrey Epstein came to light. Since the revelations, Eugenie and her family have mostly taken a backseat at royal engagements.

In June, Eugenie and her sister, Beatrice, were invited to Princess Anne’s son Peter Phillips’s wedding, but royal insiders reported that William and Kate gave them the cold shoulder. The sisters also did not attend the royal Easter celebration this year, although the palace said at the time that they would likely be invited to future events.

New babies do have a way of bringing people together, so perhaps this latest announcement (which came on the official royal family Instagram account, after all) means a return to normalcy for the beleaguered royal sisters.

Sources:

articles.title: Yikes! A Healthy Favorite Is Now Being Recalled—Here’s What You Need to Know
articles.content:
近期，冰冻蓝莓被列入了需要警惕的食品清单。继健康部门警告消费者注意葡萄球菌感染与新鲜蔬菜关联的爆发之后，又一种水果引起了关注。美国食品和药物管理局（FDA）和疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）正在调查一起涉及多个州的大肠杆菌爆发事件，该事件与Publix连锁超市销售的GreenWise有机冰冻蓝莓有关。

如果你最近采购了用于制作果汁或烘焙的冰冻水果，现在是时候检查你的冰箱了。

Publix超市已经召回了所有批次的四种GreenWise冰冻浆果产品，原因是它们可能被大肠杆菌污染。这些产品分别为：12盎司原味有机冰冻蓝莓、12盎司有机三色混合冰冻浆果、16盎司有机混合冰冻浆果和16盎司有机三色混合冰冻浆果。

根据FDA的消息，这些产品已被分发到阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州、乔治亚州、肯塔基州、北卡罗来纳州、南卡罗来纳州、田纳西州和弗吉尼亚州的Publix连锁店。虽然Publix已经于六月份将这些产品从货架上下架，但购买过的顾客被建议不要食用，而是将其丢弃或退回Publix以获得全额退款。

FDA正在继续调查污染的来源，并指出可能会有更多的产品被添加至警示名单。

截至7月30日，FDA和CDC已经确认了与这次爆发相关的12例疾病，其中包括4例住院病例。目前尚未报告任何死亡病例。

调查显示，这些有机冰冻蓝莓由智利的Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A.公司生产。在美国机构进行检查之后，FDA还将该公司的冰冻蓝莓列入了进口警示名单，以便在调查期间拦截未来的货运。

大肠杆菌是一种可能导致食源性疾病的细菌，症状通常在食用受污染的食物后几天之内出现，最长可达9天。

根据FDA的网站，常见的症状包括严重的腹痛、腹泻、发热、恶心和呕吐。虽然大多数人会在一周内康复，但某些大肠杆菌菌株可能会导致严重的血腹泻，并引发严重的并发症。

在极端情况下，感染可能会引发溶血尿毒综合征（HUS），这是一种可能威胁生命的肾衰竭形式。它还可能导致长期健康问题，包括高血压和慢性肾病。

不幸的是，冰冻食品并不能解决问题。虽然冻结食品可以减缓细菌的生长，但它不会杀死大肠杆菌。一旦受污染的食品解冻，细菌会开始重新生长，这就是为什么健康专家建议召回的产品应该被丢弃或退回超市，而不仅仅是冻结起来以备后用。

洗涤水果蔬菜也不能完全消除大肠杆菌。根据健康专家的说法，唯一可靠的杀死细菌的方法是将食物煮至内部温度至少达到73.9摄氏度。由于冰冻浆果通常是生吃的，如在果汁、酸奶或甜点中食用，消费者不会有这层额外的保护。

请保持警惕！
articles.summary:
Add frozen blueberries to the growing list of foods you may want to avoid—for now, anyway.

Just weeks after health officials warned consumers about a growing Cyclospora outbreak linked to fresh produce, another fruit has landed in the spotlight. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) are investigating a multistate E. coli outbreak linked to recalled GreenWise organic frozen blueberries sold at Publix stores across the Southeast.

So if you recently stocked up on frozen fruit for smoothies or baking, now is a good time to check your freezer.

Which frozen berries have been recalled?

Publix has recalled all lots of four GreenWise frozen berry products over concerns they may be contaminated with E. coli:

  • GreenWise Organic Whole Blueberries (10-ounce)
  • GreenWise Organic Whole Blueberries (48-ounce)
  • GreenWise Organic Whole Mixed Berries (10-ounce)
  • GreenWise Organic Whole Mixed Berries (48-ounce)

According to the FDA, the products were distributed to Publix locations in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia.

The retailer had already removed the products from shelves in June, but customers who purchased them are being urged not to eat them. Instead, they should either throw them away or return them to Publix for a full refund.

The FDA is continuing to investigate the source of the contamination and noted that additional products could be added to the advisory.

The outbreak has already sickened 12 people

As of July 30, the FDA and CDC have identified 12 illnesses connected to the outbreak, including four hospitalizations. No deaths have been reported at this time.

The investigation has been traced to organic frozen blueberries produced by Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A. in Chile. Following the agency’s inspection, the FDA also placed frozen blueberries from the company on an import alert, allowing future shipments to be detained while the investigation continues.

What is E. coli—and what are the symptoms?

E. coli is a type of bacteria that can cause foodborne illness, with symptoms typically appearing anywhere from a few days after eating contaminated food to as long as nine days later.

According to the FDA’s website, common symptoms include severe stomach cramps, diarrhea, fever, nausea and vomiting. While many people recover within a week, certain strains of E. coli can cause severe bloody diarrhea and lead to serious complications.

In extreme cases, the infection can trigger hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS), a potentially life-threatening form of kidney failure. It may also lead to long-term health issues, including high blood pressure and chronic kidney disease.

Does freezing kill E. coli?

Unfortunately, no.

While freezing food can slow the growth of bacteria, it does not kill E. coli. Once contaminated food thaws, the bacteria can begin growing again, which is why health officials say recalled products should be thrown away or returned to the store—not simply frozen until later.

Washing produce also isn’t enough to eliminate E. coli. According to health experts, the only reliable way to kill the bacteria is by cooking food to an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees. Because frozen berries are typically eaten raw in smoothies, yogurt or desserts, consumers won’t have that added layer of protection.

Stay safe out there!
